newsitem.title: CHINA: Reuters 4th ex-Hong Kong to Americas cargo report.
newsitem.headline: Reuters 4th ex-Hong Kong to Americas cargo report.

text.p: Current average ex-Hong Kong air cargo market rates in Hong Kong dollars per kg for a 100kg shipment, with volume-to-weight of six to one.
*The rates quoted in this report were obtained by Reuter journalists on a confidential basis from a range of airlines, large forwarders and smaller air cargo agents.
*All prices are quoted in HK dollars.

*The tariffs represent average rates calculated from a range of prices, including standard, discount and spot rates, and are indicative of current activity. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
